family.description: Protocol-v3 rerun of the preserved raw carry-less batch comparison. Both arms rebuild from the immutable source closure of the accepted v1 confirmation: the baseline requires AVX512VL and selects sequential PCLMULQDQ on Zen 3; the candidate selects the repaired YMM VPCLMULQDQ lane. The v1 evidence remains immutable and superseded.

effect.rationale: The exploratory threshold reflects the hypothesis under test: a two-wide VPCLMULQDQ lane that replaces one PCLMULQDQ per product is worth its dispatch domain only when the raw batch gains at least a tenth of its time. The pilot exists to measure the resolution that must lie below it.
effect.equivalence_rationale: The FieldVec dot product is called inside larger linear-algebra routines, where a regression up to five percent stays inside the noise those routines already carry. The pilot estimates whether the host resolves an effect that small.
effect.material_gap_rationale: Declared for completeness. No comparator-gap cell exists in this family because no external library exposes an independent raw carry-less batch product to compare against.

complexity_budget.maintenance_rationale: The repair adds no kernel: it corrects the feature contract of an existing one and publishes the lane it selects. Sixty-five net production lines, most of them the safety and dispatch documentation the corrected contract requires, fit inside a budget of eighty.
